newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Malaysian prime minister wins Saudi Arabia's King Faisal International Prize.
- Interior ministry urges private sector to employ more Saudis in their firms.
- Saudi Arabia and India sign a contract to supply liquefied gas to India from this month.
- Two workers died and a third was missing when a building collapsed in the Saudi capital Riyadh on Tuesday.
